patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Navigate into the 'the_yolk_street_data' folder, then into the 'StreamingAssets' folder, and then into the 'StandaloneWindows' folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the 'patch.unity3d' file from the downloaded patch archive into the 'StandaloneWindows' folder m It's working if: An '18+' symbol appears in the lower right hand of the title screen.
